newsitem.title: USA: Nebraska fed cattle light $110/dressed - private.
newsitem.headline: Nebraska fed cattle light $110/dressed - private.

text.p: Nebraska feedlot cattle sales were light near midday on Tuesday at $110.00 per cwt on a dressed basis, market sources said.
The sales were steady with the bulk of last week's trade, but down $1.00 from last week's top, they said.
About 2,000 head sold early, mostly on a dressed basis, they said. Further bids at $111.00 were passed by owners pricing cattle at $112.00.
There also were light sales reported at $69.00 per cwt on a live basis from feedlots in the western part of the state, the sources said.
